# Multi-system coverage of HCMO 0.3.0

Coverage is computed from each system's reviewed mapping table (`hcmo-mapping.tsv`): every native concept or export variable is mapped to an HCMO term (**hcmo**), expressed through a reused external term in the HCMO pattern (**external**), expressed only partially or through a generic pattern (**partial**), or deliberately left uncovered (**not-covered**). `% mapped` counts hcmo + external + partial; `% HCMO-native` counts hcmo only.

## Gaps and partial mappings

### Tecniplast DVC (Digital Ventilated Cage)

| Native concept | Mapping | HCMO target | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| position | partial | hcm:locatedIn -> schema:Place | Only the latest position is kept: hcm:locatedIn is not time-bounded, so position history is lost. |
| group (B6_M) | partial | hcm-bio:ExperimentalGroup (cohort), schema:isPartOf | Strain and sex cannot be asserted on a group in 0.3.0 (hcm-bio:hasStrain/hasBiologicalSex have domain Subject); recorded as rdfs:comment. |
| animals in a cage | partial | hcm-bio:ExperimentalGroup (one per cage), hcm-bio:hasHousingAssignment | Cage-level group with unknown membership; individual hcm-bio:Subject instances cannot be created. |
| event = REGISTERED / ADDED / CAGE_ONLINE / UPDATED | not-covered | — | Software lifecycle events without a home-cage meaning; deliberately out of scope. |
| day / hour / minute / relativeTime | partial | time:inXSDDateTime | Derivable from the timestamp; not materialised separately. |
| per-cage smoothed activation index | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, qudt:numericValue, unit:PERCENT, hcm-obs:occursIn | No HCMO observation subtype accepts a numeric activity result about a cage group; the generic sosa:Observation is used. |
| <GROUP>_AVG / _SEM / _QRT / _SAMPLES | not-covered | — | Statistical summaries are derivable from the per-cage observations; HCMO records primary observations only. |
| raw electrode capacitance stream | not-covered | — | Not present in the export; would map to hcm-tech:TimeSeries if available. |
| rack temperature / relative humidity | not-covered | — | Would map to hcm-obs:EnvironmentObservation with hcm-env:EnvironmentalProperty; absent from cohort 7623 files. |
| Bedding Status Index / Urination Index | not-covered | — | Dual environmental/physiological role; absent from cohort 7623 files. |
| light programme (Leddy) | not-covered | — | hcm-env:LightCycle would apply; the export does not state the light schedule, so dark-phase questions are unanswerable for DVC. |


### TSE PhenoMaster (indirect calorimetry, feeding, drinking, activity)

| Native concept | Mapping | HCMO target | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| VO2(1) [ml/h] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:MilliL-PER-HR, sosa:usedProcedure | No HCMO metabolic observation subtype; generic sosa:Observation about the subject. |
| VCO2(1) [ml/h] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:MilliL-PER-HR | As VO2. |
| RER | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:UNITLESS | As VO2. |
| H(1) [kcal/h] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:KiloCAL_TH-PER-HR | QUDT 3.4.0 has no generic kcal/h unit; the thermochemical kilocalorie per hour is used. |
| Feed1 [g] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:GM | Cumulative value; HCMO does not distinguish cumulative from interval quantities. |
| Drink1 [ml] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:MilliL | As Feed1. |
| XT+YT [Cnt] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:NUM | Generic sosa:Observation. |
| Z [Cnt] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:NUM | Generic sosa:Observation. |
| Ref.O2 / Ref.CO2 [%] | not-covered | — | Calibration/reference channel of the analyzer; deliberately out of scope. |
| Flow [l/min] | not-covered | — | Device operating parameter; no HCMO sensor-setting property besides sampling rate. |


### Noldus PhenoTyper with EthoVision XT

| Native concept | Mapping | HCMO target | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trial / Trial ID | not-covered | — | No protocol/trial entity in HCMO 0.3.0; the ISA evidence slice covers this outside the core. |
| Area / Areachange / Elongation | not-covered | — | Per-sample shape descriptors are not materialised; they stay in the referenced track file. |
| Distance moved [cm] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:CentiM, sosa:usedProcedure | No HCMO locomotion observation subtype; generic sosa:Observation. |
| Velocity mean [cm/s] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:CentiM-PER-SEC | Generic sosa:Observation. |
| In zone(Shelter) duration [s] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:SEC | Zone semantics (shelter) live in the observable-property label only. |
| Movement(Moving) duration [s] | partial | sosa:Observation, hcm-obs:QuantityValue, unit:SEC | Generic sosa:Observation. |
| Video file | not-covered | — | Only the CSV exports are referenced as hcm-tech:TimeSeries; the video itself is not modelled. |
| Missing values marker | not-covered | — | File-format detail; out of scope. |
